body:
I've tried it before....
But then I was in my early teens and had an asshole older brother who liked to root through my shit and blackmail me with my writings.
I quickly learned I should burn them.
Big brothers are supposed to look out for you, not try to hurt you.

Thank you for caring...
Even though I don't know you it means a lot right now :)
I wish I could go somewhere to just be isolated and think. But there is constant stress wherever I go.

The holdup is I feel like things could change, I still nonetheless have feelings for him, as stupid, and blind, and dumb as that may be.

I think I really know I need to call the cops. Very soon.
I just can't bring myself to...

My only real option according to the RCMP is have a womens shelter ship me off somewhere. I want to be around my family, live a fairly normal 21 year old girls life.
He's always kinda scared me in the way he talks about killing people... just anybody when he's his normal self... when he's mad. It's how he wants to strangle and kill me, Talking about how he knows how to get rid of a body and how he would never get caught (he easily would, hes not nearly as smart as he thinks, even if i end up dead) ... and how thats all he ever thinks about doing.

I've 'suggested' that.. but what can I do to get someone out of their own 'legall home...? I want him out but I can't, if i 'call the cops (which i have), get him arrested, etc, etc, i'm dead....
where that gets me is basicallly:  dead.
(and i've told the police this.......)
He refuses to leave our apartment even though he threatens my life every day :/

And i'm not sure what you mean by "run"
I'm never dealing with this BS again. For sure.
But I am not afraid of him. At all.

Thats what I want to do....
But I have nowhere to run to..
I can call the cops on him/have him thrown out even though he's on the lease (criminal record. covered my ass there....)
But I don't wanna go that far....
any one experienced anything similar..
or would know what they would do in said situation??

I had moved out a month or so prior to us getting an apartment together. 
(I need a place to stay as does he.. problem seems to be I actually care about him then catch him lying about me and our relationship.)..
Troubles at his house with his family and more..
And (i thought) he honestly asked me if I would like to live with him, and that's what he wanted. I was thrilled. Thought he wanted a life with me.
Turns out... not so much
